titel: Confluence: Onboarding checklist for new sales hires
text:
Confluence-Seite Onboarding checklist for new sales hires (ID 40101)
Bereich: Sales
Autor: Priya Anand  Stand: 2026-08-04

## First week
On day one request access to the CRM and the ticket system; approval takes one business day, everything else depends on it. On day two join the sales channel and shadow a discovery call. On day four give the demo to Priya Anand. The sales channel is faster than direct messages.

Confluence-Seite Refund policy (ID 40102)
Bereich: Finance
Autor: Greta Mills  Stand: 2026-05-11

## Policy
Customers can cancel within 30 days of the first invoice for a full refund. After that, refunds are prorated for annual plans only. Refunds above 10.000 USD need approval from Greta Mills and a second signature from the CEO.

Confluence-Seite Pricing and discounts (ID 40103)
Bereich: Sales
Autor: Marek Voss  Stand: 2026-09-01

## List prices (valid from 2026-09-01)
Starter 12 USD per user and month, Business 24 USD, Enterprise on request. Sales may grant up to 10 percent discount alone; 10 to 20 percent needs the head of sales; above 20 percent needs the CEO.

Confluence-Seite Pricing and discounts - copy (ID 40104)
Bereich: Sales
Autor: Marek Voss  Stand: 2026-03-15

## List prices (valid from 2026-03-15)
Starter 10 USD per user and month, Business 20 USD, Enterprise on request. Sales may grant up to 15 percent discount alone. (Old version, kept as a draft.)

Confluence-Seite Incident process (ID 40105)
Bereich: Engineering
Autor: Dev Raman  Stand: 2026-06-20

## Severity
Sev1: customer-facing outage, page the on-call engineer immediately, status page update within 15 minutes. Sev2: degraded service, fix within one business day. Sev3: everything else, normal backlog. After every Sev1 a written post-mortem is due within 5 working days.

titel: Confluence: Northgate Brewing - Lessons from the Pilot
text:
Confluence-Seite Northgate Brewing - Lessons from the Pilot (ID 40109)
Bereich: Customer Success
Autor: Ines Calloway  Stand: 2026-08-30

## Lessons
The pilot with Northgate Brewing ran for 8 weeks in 40 pubs. Late deliveries dropped from 18 to 6 percent. The expansion to a second brewery was lost to a competitor on price.

Confluence-Seite Data retention (ID 40110)
Bereich: Legal
Autor: Greta Mills  Stand: 2026-04-02

## Rule
Customer data is deleted 90 days after the contract ends. Backups are deleted after a further 35 days. Audit logs are kept for 7 years.
